usage: Used to describe a colour that is darker than normal grey. 呢件冷衫係深灰色。
Common for clothes and everyday items. 我買咗條深灰色褲。
Can be used for furniture or home decor. 條梳化係深灰色，好襟睇。
You can use it when comparing shades. 呢隻深灰色比嗰隻淺好多。
